editingGuide.cardTabMembership: Each card has a tabs array. Add multiple tab IDs to show the same card in multiple tabs.
editingGuide.workTimelineRelationships: Each timeline or community engagement has a unique id. Add one or more of those IDs to a work file's engagementIds array to associate it with multiple engagements.
editingGuide.communityDates: Use YYYY-MM in startDate and endDate. Leave endDate empty for an ongoing role. A periodLabel such as Ongoing overrides the calculated date range.
editingGuide.projectOrder: Keep ongoing client work first, followed by client projects in reverse order of their latest recorded date (end date, or start date when the end is unknown). Place community work after dated client projects and projects with no recorded dates last. Array order controls the archive and its featured first card.
